d:
The Supreme Court has suspended the life sentences of two of the 11 men convicted in the 2002 Bilkis Bano case and granted them bail. The two convicts, Bipinchand Kanaiyalal Joshi and Pradip Ramanlal Modhiya, had spent more than 17 years in prison. The court cited their prolonged incarceration, the severe physical disability of one convict and questions of fact and law pending in their appeals.
This comes nearly three years after the Supreme Court overturned the Gujarat government's decision to grant remission to all 11 convicts in August 2022, directing them to return to prison.
